faqs.question: PCTE was established in which year
faqs.answer: PCTE (Punjab College of Technical Education), Ludhiana was established in 1999 and has completed 27+ years of educational excellence; it celebrated its 25th anniversary in 2024. It was founded by Wg. Cdr. HS Gill, Dr. K.N.S. Kang and Harpreet K. Kang.

faqs.question: How many campuses does PCTE have
faqs.answer: PCTE has two campuses in Ludhiana. Campus 1: Baddowal, Ferozpur Road, Ludhiana-142021, Punjab. Campus 2: Near Baddowal Cantt, Ferozepur Road, Ludhiana-142021, Punjab. The boys hostel is in Jhande Village, at walking distance from Campus 2.

faqs.question: What events fests does PCTE have Koshish Ehsaas Turf
faqs.answer: PCTE's three flagship events are Koshish, Ehsaas and Turf - usually held around October each year. Koshish is an intra-college cultural-literary fest, Ehsaas is a large inter-college cultural/literary/arts mega fest, and Turf is an inter-school event for management, literary, cultural and hospitality competitions.

faqs.question: Does PCTE have a sports day
faqs.answer: Yes! PCTE holds an annual sports festival/sports day, usually around February-March, where faculty also join in alongside students. Sports include Cricket, Football, Basketball, Volleyball, Badminton, Tug of War, Shot Put, Table Tennis and Pool, plus an athletics track and gym for regular training.

faqs.question: What is the PCTE Instagram page
faqs.answer: PCTE's official Instagram page is pcteofficial (instagram.com/pcteofficial). Facebook: facebook.com/pctegroup. Twitter/X: @pcteofficial. LinkedIn: linkedin.com/school/pcte-ludhiana.

faqs.question: Tell me the full history old and new achievements rankings of PCTE
faqs.answer: PCTE was established in 1999, founded by Wg. Cdr. HS Gill, Dr. K.N.S. Kang and Harpreet K. Kang, and celebrated its 25th anniversary in 2024. Today it has 4,772 students on campus, 400+ international students (students and alumni from 65 countries), 30 international university collaborations and 303+ companies visiting every year. Highest package is 70 LPA. Recent rankings (2025-2026) include: Times B School Survey 2025 - 9th best BBA school among private B-schools in India; India Today MDRA 2025 - 4th best BBA, Hotel Management and 9th best BCA college in Punjab; Business Today MDRA 2025 - 3rd best private B-school in Punjab; Outlook-ICARE 2026 - 5th best private B-school in Punjab. Older awards include Best Management College 2015 and Best Hotel Management and Pharmacy College 2014 (PTU), plus B-school leadership awards in 2010-2013.

faqs.question: How are PCTE placements companies recruiters package highest average
faqs.answer: From the official brochure: highest package 70 LPA (also 55 LPA - 10 students and 45 LPA - 23 students), average package 7 LPA, 303+ companies visit every year, 50+ companies in the Mega Job Fair, and international placements with Omni Hotels & Resorts USA and United Airlines USA. Recruiters include Amazon, Goldman Sachs, HDFC, ICICI, Axis, Marriott, Taj, Oberoi, Emirates, Qatar Airways, Cipla, Sun Pharma, Mankind, Nestle, HUL, ITC and more.

faqs.question: PCTE Faculty of Engineering Technology B.Tech programs established infrastructure
faqs.answer: The Faculty of Engineering and Technology was established in 2019 and offers four UG programs: B.Tech CSE, B.Tech CSE (AI & ML), B.Tech Civil and B.Tech Mechanical. All are AICTE approved and affiliated to I.K. Gujral Punjab Technical University. The institute is centrally air conditioned with smart classrooms and well-equipped laboratories.

faqs.question: B.Tech CSE computer science eligibility seats specialization Zscaler package
faqs.answer: B.Tech CSE: 4 years, 210 seats. Eligibility: 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics compulsory, plus one of Chemistry / Computer Science / Electronics / IT / Biology / Informatics Practices / Biotechnology / Technical Vocational subject / Agriculture / Engineering Graphics / Business Studies / Entrepreneurship. Core specializations: Data science, Software design & development, Multimedia & Computer Vision, Information & Cyber Security. Highlights: Crewsphere & ICP web3 projects (tokenized asset management, blockchain identity verification, decentralised voting), 9 MoUs (Novem Controls, Solitaire Infosys, Cresphere ICP India), 100+ placement/internship partner companies, live projects and internships. A student was placed at Zscaler with Rs. 19.5 lakh package.

faqs.question: B.Tech AI ML artificial intelligence machine learning eligibility seats research
faqs.answer: B.Tech CSE (AI & ML): 4 years, 90 seats, department established in 2024 at PCTE Institute of Engineering. Eligibility same as CSE (10+2 with Physics and Mathematics plus one more listed subject). Research areas: Deep Learning, Generative AI, ML optimization, Bayesian learning, Reinforcement Learning, Algorithms for massive datasets, Causal inference, Conversational AI, NLP. Aim: make students leaders in the AI industry and academia. Also has Crewsphere & ICP web3 exposure, 9 MoUs and Zscaler Rs. 19.5 lakh placement mention.

faqs.question: B.Tech Mechanical engineering eligibility seats labs specializations COBOT
faqs.answer: B.Tech Mechanical Engineering: 4 years, 30 seats, eligibility 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics compulsory. Labs: Applied Thermodynamics, CAD/CAM, Automation, Robotics & Mechatronics, Fluid Mechanics, Heat Transfer, Manufacturing Technology, Metallurgy & Heat Treatment. Specializations: AutoCAD & Simulation, Mechatronics & Automation, Energy Engineering, Automobile Engineering, Manufacturing & Robotics. Student forum 'Yantriki'; industrial visits to SML Isuzu, RCF Kapurthala, International Tractors, Verka Milk Plant etc. In 2026 students built a low-cost FDM 3D printer and did a 45-day COBOT training.

faqs.question: B.Tech Civil engineering eligibility seats software internship dam visit
faqs.answer: B.Tech Civil Engineering: 4 years, 30 seats, eligibility 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics compulsory. Specializations: Structural Engineering & Construction Management, Environmental Engineering, Transportation. Software: AUTOCAD, BIM, GEOSTADIA, STAAD PRO. Six-month internship, survey camps, student forum 'Constructors', industrial visits to Ambuja Cement, Punjab Irrigation Dept, National Fertilizers, Shahpur Kandi Dam and Bhakra Nangal Dam.

faqs.question: BHMCT hotel management eligibility seats world records industrial training
faqs.answer: BHMCT (Hotel Management & Catering Technology): 4 years, 180 seats, AICTE approved. Eligibility: 10+2 any stream with minimum 50% marks (general) and 45% (other categories). The department is built like a mock hotel with front desk, banquet, hotel room, laundry, bakery and restaurants (Indian Angeethi, Cubs Cafe). 6-month international/domestic industrial training in 5th semester (Mauritius, Dubai, Malaysia, USA, Greece, France; Oberoi, Taj, Marriott). Records: 1241 varieties of parathas in 9 min 10 sec (Guinness/Limca), world's largest thali 96 inch with 270 dishes (2019), 114 coffee varieties (2022), 524 millet samosa variations (2024). 23 students got the highest package of Rs. 70 lakh in the USA.

faqs.question: BTTM travel tourism eligibility seats cabin crew passport placement United Airlines
faqs.answer: BTTM (Travel & Tourism Management): 4 years, 60 seats, eligibility 10+2 any stream. Features: in-house airline lab and cabin crew training, every student processes at least 20 passports per semester, training in travel agencies (tour packages, visas, air ticketing, IRCTC), AIESEC association, Globetrotter quiz. Placements: United Airlines, Singapore Airlines, Air Asia, Indigo, MakeMyTrip, Thomas Cook, tourism boards of Bhutan, Lesotho, Punjab and J&K. One student secured Rs. 50 lakh as Cabin Crew at United Airlines.
